task.objective: Improve expected unseen Challenge 2 score while preserving a valid deterministic submission.
task.interface: One row at a time: seq_ix, step_in_seq, need_prediction, 112 float32 features; no test targets or is_scored mask.
invariants: Process all rows in order, including rows where need_prediction is false.
Predict using only features through the current row.
Reset sequence-local mutable state on seq_ix change.
No inference update may use t0/t1, future rows, the hidden scored mask, or prior test sequences.
task.evaluation_exposure: Existing validation folds are exposed. They support development screening only; public-transfer claims require prospective external evidence.

existing_controls: Active H230 source includes cumulative causal online_zscore_torch features.
Active H230 source includes a prefix-conditioned adapter using up to the first 99 rows.
Historical E-078 label-delayed ceiling assumes true evaluated labels after a lag and is not an available test-time information set.

directed_sources.citation: Sun et al., Test-Time Training with Self-Supervision for Generalization under Distribution Shifts, ICML 2020.
directed_sources.transfer_limit: General unlabeled-input update pattern only; image-rotation objective and reported gains do not transfer as evidence.

directed_sources.citation: Arik, Yoder, and Pfister, Self-Adaptive Forecasting for Improved Deep Learning on Non-Stationary Time-Series, 2022.
directed_sources.transfer_limit: Backcasting inspires input-only adaptation within an observed causal window; never access future sequence rows.

directed_sources.citation: Chen et al., Test-Time Training for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting, SIAM SDM 2024.
directed_sources.transfer_limit: Self-supervised reconstruction without target labels; their many-location effective batch differs from 112 correlated features here.

directed_sources.citation: Wang et al., Continual Test-Time Domain Adaptation, CVPR 2022.
directed_sources.transfer_limit: Teacher averaging and stochastic restoration motivate drift controls, not their classification result.

directed_sources.citation: Wu et al., Test-Time Adaptation for Non-stationary Time Series: From Synthetic Regime Shifts to Financial Markets, arXiv:2602.00073, 2026 preprint.
directed_sources.transfer_limit: Recent task-matched preprint; treat as external hypothesis context, not replicated Challenge 2 evidence.

directed_sources.citation: Kim et al., Battling the Non-stationarity in Time Series Forecasting via Test-time Adaptation, AAAI 2025.
directed_sources.transfer_limit: Uses partially observed ground truth; that component is excluded by the Challenge 2 callback.

directed_sources.citation: Wang et al., Adaptive Learning of Smoothing Functions: Application to Electricity Load Forecasting, NeurIPS 2012.
directed_sources.transfer_limit: RLS with labels arriving online transfers only as a supervised training-time optimization pattern.

random_library_draw.procedure: Sort the 14 unique absolute PDF paths; Python random.Random(seed).choice(paths); use the same RNG to choose a 1-based PDF page after reading page count.
random_library_draw.work: Livan, Novaes, and Vivo, Introduction to Random Matrices: Theory and Practice.
random_library_draw.exact_passage: Any time you need a matrix which is too complicated to study, you can try replacing it with a random matrix
random_library_draw.transfer: Compare a rolling feature-innovation covariance spectrum with a training-only block-shuffle null to trigger sparse adaptation; this is an analogy, not predictive evidence.

cards.title: Robust two-timescale feature-state normalization
cards.intervention: Keep model weights fixed. Maintain fast and slow exponentially weighted locations/scales per feature channel; normalize current x_t with statistics from x_<t, keep raw input as a parallel view, then update state with x_t. Bound statistic updates using train-fitted innovation caps. Train with the identical causal transform.

exact_information_set.predict: x_0 through x_t and statistics derived from x_0 through x_(t-1).
exact_information_set.update: x_t only, after prediction; also update on warmup rows.

cards.reset_policy: Clear all locations, scales, and buffers when seq_ix changes; fixed model weights and train-fitted caps persist.
source_components: Online normalization estimation in MixNorm and the recent time-series TTA preprint.
cards.structural_analogy: Track within-sequence scale drift with a causal state estimate while retaining raw scale information.
cards.overlap_and_boundary: Compare against active H230 cumulative online_zscore_torch and its first-99-row prefix-conditioned adapter; historical online-norm branches mean this is a dynamic robust-timescale descendant, not a new claim for static normalization.
assumptions_and_breakpoints: Feature location/scale drift is present and relevant to prediction.
Normalization does not erase predictive absolute scale.
The train transform matches the inference update order.
cards.cheapest_decisive_test: Replay one own checkpoint on one fixed exposed outer group with frozen normalization, current cumulative online-zscore, one-timescale EW, fast/slow EW, and shuffled-statistics sham. Continue to a tiny matched fit only if the dynamic state produces plausible target-aligned change.
cards.predicted_observable: A complete official endpoint improvement on sequences with causal feature scale movement, near-anchor behavior on stable sequences.
cards.falsifier: No improvement over cumulative normalization, no residual contribution conditional on the anchor, or similar gain with shuffled statistics.
cards.teacher_compression_path: Distill an own larger teacher's input-state-conditioned predictions into an independently trained compact GRU and compare with/without the dynamic transform.
cards.cpu_serving_cost_estimate: Under 1 KB mutable state and O(112) scalar work per row; unmeasured and must be profiled in the compiled serving path.
cards.bounded_gpu_training_path: After root admission and actual shape/resource profile: one compact own-weight candidate/control paired seed, one declared group split, at most one epoch or one tenth of the current recipe's updates, whichever is smaller.
risks: Feature scaling may be economically irrelevant

cards.title: Sparse self-supervised fast adapter with supervised outer training
cards.intervention: Freeze an own causal backbone and train a rank-4 to rank-8 adapter to improve a supervised outer objective after one regularized inner update on masked-channel or short-window feature reconstruction. At inference, update sparsely from an observed rolling window ending at t, anchored to initial adapter weights.

exact_information_set.predict: x_0 through x_t after an update whose reconstruction window contains only already observed rows.
exact_information_set.update: Current and past feature rows within the rolling window; no target or predicted-target pseudo-label.
exact_information_set.outer_training: Permitted training features/labels only; validation targets remain grader-only.

cards.reset_policy: Reset adapter fast state, reconstruction buffer, and update cadence when seq_ix changes; static backbone and adapter initialization persist.
source_components: Self-supervised updates from one unlabeled test sample in Sun et al.
Teacher anchoring/restoration as drift control in CoTTA.
cards.structural_analogy: Use the current causal feature window as a self-supervised adaptation set; meta-train on labeled episodes so the feature update helps the supervised forecast.
assumptions_and_breakpoints: Feature reconstruction gradients align with useful forecast representation changes.
Sparse updates can adapt before a local regime is over.
The update remains stable without test labels or future rows.
cards.cheapest_decisive_test: Freeze one own backbone and train only a low-rank adapter; on one exposed outer group compare no update, regularized sparse update, random-gradient sham, and unanchored adaptation. Grade the full endpoint, drift, reconstruction loss, and serving latency.
cards.predicted_observable: Improved full endpoint in shifted feature regimes, small update norms, and transfer across held-out sequence groups.
cards.falsifier: Reconstruction improves but target endpoint does not; sham is similar; outputs drift over sequence length; or the update exceeds serving time.
cards.teacher_compression_path: Train a larger own adaptation-aware teacher and distill post-update outputs/states into an independently trained compact GRU student that keeps the causal sequence state without test-time backprop.
cards.cpu_serving_cost_estimate: Highest of these cards. Rank-4 adapter updates every 128 or 256 rows are estimated to add small-window buffer memory and sparse matrix-gradient work; exact latency is unmeasured. Require a compiled update and full 1-vCPU/60-minute test-set benchmark before promotion.
cards.bounded_gpu_training_path: After root admission and actual-shape profile: one frozen own backbone, one adapter rank, one seed, one sequence-group outer split, at most one epoch or one tenth of the parent recipe's updates. Defer teacher/student expansion to separate admission.
risks: Sparse update cadence may miss short regimes

cards.title: Feature-only Bayesian regime filtering over fixed experts
cards.intervention: Train a small bank of own experts and a diagonal feature-emission model on training groups. Update a K-state posterior per row from feature innovations and a learned transition matrix; mix fixed expert outputs using the posterior. No model parameter updates occur at inference.

exact_information_set.predict: Current x_t, past features and posterior q_(t-1), plus fixed expert predictions from causal recurrent states.
exact_information_set.update: Feature-only observation vector derived through t; transition/emission models trained on allowed training inputs.

cards.reset_policy: Initialize from train-fitted prior and clear posterior/observation state at each seq_ix change; static experts/emissions remain fixed.
source_components: Online regime tracking in continual adaptation literature.
cards.structural_analogy: Adapt the mixture weights as a filtered belief over observable input regimes rather than by gradient descent.
assumptions_and_breakpoints: Input-only emissions identify states where expert residual behavior differs.
Regime posterior can change without becoming unstable.
The expert bank carries conditional complementarity.
cards.cheapest_decisive_test: Where eligible own experts exist, fit diagonal emissions/transitions from training inputs only and compare equal fixed mixture, posterior mixture, constant posterior, and sequence-order-shuffled posterior on the same exposed outer group. Train experts only if cross-fitted state already predicts residual complementarity.
cards.predicted_observable: Posterior changes track input shifts and improve the complete mixture endpoint over fixed/shuffled controls.
cards.falsifier: Feature likelihood does not predict expert usefulness, posterior collapses without gain, or equal/shuffled controls match.
cards.teacher_compression_path: Use a larger own expert bank as teacher and distill the posterior mixture into a compact recurrent student; retain the fixed mixture and student as separate endpoints.
cards.cpu_serving_cost_estimate: K=4 to 8 diagonal likelihoods over 8 to 32 features cost O(KF) per row and a few KB sequence state; unmeasured.
cards.bounded_gpu_training_path: Start with existing ancestry-audited own experts and a CPU-only filter fit. If experts must be trained, cap the first cohort at one compact four-expert seed, one sequence-group split, one epoch or one tenth of the current recipe's updates; require root admission.
risks: Static expert bank may lack complementarity
Posterior may respond to scale instead of predictive regime

cards.title: Supervised prequential training with frozen deployment weights
cards.intervention: During permitted training only, predict each chronological row/chunk with current weights, then update a small readout after its supplied training label becomes available, using a predeclared delay and forgetting factor. Export final weights and freeze them at inference.

exact_information_set.training_predict: Training features through current row and only training labels whose predeclared availability time has passed.
exact_information_set.inference_predict: Current and prior test features only; trained weights are frozen.
excluded: future training label in prequential prediction

cards.reset_policy: Reset recurrent/sequence context at each sequence boundary during training; optimizer's declared training state is logged. No sequence-adapted readout state is exported for test inference.
source_components: Recursive least squares with forgetting for labeled online smoothing in the NeurIPS 2012 load-forecasting paper.
cards.structural_analogy: Apply label-driven online optimization as a training recipe under chronology, then deploy one fixed checkpoint.
assumptions_and_breakpoints: Training sequence order contains a useful optimization signal beyond shuffled minibatch training.
A final frozen checkpoint captures any benefit after temporal training dynamics stop.
The chosen training delay matches the declared offline recipe, not an assumed test label feed.
cards.cheapest_decisive_test: One paired run from the same own initialization: chronological prequential readout updates versus current standard training with equal optimizer updates/compute, plus chronological-order-shuffled control. Evaluate fixed held-out groups only after training completes.
cards.predicted_observable: A better final frozen checkpoint at equal training budget, not a gain that exists only while labels continue to arrive.
cards.falsifier: No gain against both controls, gain depends on target updates during evaluation, or paired seed results do not hold.
cards.teacher_compression_path: If the frozen prequential model helps, use it as an own fixed teacher for an ordinary independently trained student.
cards.cpu_serving_cost_estimate: No added inference adaptation cost; frozen model latency is the same as its architecture/control.
cards.bounded_gpu_training_path: One candidate/control paired seed, one fold, equal update count, at most one epoch or one tenth of the current recipe's updates, whichever is smaller; root admission and device profile required.
risks: May duplicate ordinary SGD order effects
Sequential optimization may overfit late training sequences

cards.title: Random-matrix innovation trigger for sparse adaptation
cards.intervention: Maintain a rank-3 or rank-4 online covariance approximation of feature increments. Every 64 or 128 rows compare the leading eigenvalue with a threshold calibrated from block-shuffled training segments; trigger a small OL-2 update or raise OL-3 transition responsiveness only when a spike occurs.

exact_information_set.predict: Feature increments and rolling covariance through t, with only train-fitted thresholds.
exact_information_set.update: Current and past features; statistic state resets per sequence.

cards.reset_policy: Reset covariance factors, buffer, and trigger cooldown on seq_ix change; static threshold persists.
source_components: Livan, Novaes, Vivo, Introduction to Random Matrices: Theory and Practice, printed page 5, random library draw.
cards.structural_analogy: Compare a complicated rolling feature covariance with an empirical random/block-shuffle baseline; a spectral outlier may mark coherent input change.
assumptions_and_breakpoints: The null preserves enough serial dependence for valid trigger calibration.
A spike indicates a context where the declared adaptation helps.
Feature co-movement is not merely nuisance volatility.
cards.cheapest_decisive_test: On a small predeclared exposed sequence sample, test whether trigger windows enrich for cross-fitted anchor residual magnitude or candidate-minus-anchor value versus equal-rate random triggers and the block-shuffle null. No GPU until this passes.
cards.predicted_observable: Sparse triggers detect coordinated feature movement and concentrate windows where the online update improves the official endpoint.
cards.falsifier: Null-like trigger frequency, no residual enrichment, or no gain over equal-rate random timing.
cards.teacher_compression_path: Use only as an update scheduler for an own larger teacher; distill its state-conditioned predictions into a compact student if the trigger ablation passes.
cards.cpu_serving_cost_estimate: Rank-4 state around 2 KB; O(112 times 4) arithmetic per update boundary, proposed every 64 or 128 rows. Compiled latency is unmeasured.
cards.bounded_gpu_training_path: Initial signal test is CPU-only. If positive, interact with only one already admitted OL-2 or OL-3 cohort; do not add a separate fit budget before root review.
risks: Textbook random matrix assumptions fail under serial correlation
Threshold selection can overfit exposed data
Detector may trigger on volatility without predictive meaning
